reference.source: Dhingra Diseases of ENT 8th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Snoring plus pauses plus sleepiness means study
CPAP first line adult moderate severe
reference.pathophysiology: Repeated inspiratory suction against a closed pharynx (Starling resistor) traumatises soft tissues into oedema and laxity, while fragmented sleep and chemoreceptor surges reset sympathetic tone upward, entrenching hypertension and arrhythmia substrates.
additionalDifferentials: Obstructive versus central apnoea by effort on study
Habitual snoring versus OSA by symptoms and AHI
Palatal versus tongue base collapse by sleep endoscopy
additionalInvestigations: Epworth sleepiness scale and witnessed history
Polysomnography or home testing with AHI and oximetry
Drug induced sleep endoscopy for surgical mapping
